title: DF-6 rule-engine hardening: missing optional inputs in exception predicates route to indeterminate/PRR, never silently false
objective: In services/api/app/rules/evaluator.py, make _apply_exceptions detect when an exception condition reads a missing optional input (reuse _predicate_input_names) and route the evaluation to the existing indeterminate/COVERAGE_PROFESSIONAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED path with a trace note naming the missing input and indeterminate exception, instead of the current fail-open two-valued False that silently skips a coverage-downgrading exception; preserve required/applicability indeterminate behavior and all present-input behavior unchanged; NO contract or schema change (rule_evaluation.schema.json byte-unchanged; reuse existing trace/notes fields) - if a contract change proves genuinely necessary, return needs_split instead of changing it.
business_reason: D-003 second-wave lane 3 (D-003-R023) selected by owner decision 2026-07-30 (D-004-R300, source-008): the second of the two disjoint D-004 Step-4 producer-pilot tasks. DF-6 (WHOLE-SYSTEM-TRUST-REPLAN-2026-07-23, High): fail-open miss of an escalation - deterministic code must never silently evaluate a missing legal input as False.
inputs: DF-6 defect record (WHOLE-SYSTEM-TRUST-REPLAN-2026-07-23 defect table) + D-003-R023 lane 3
Evaluator internals: _eval_predicate (two-valued), _apply_exceptions fail-open skip, _predicate_input_names helper, optional_missing computation, existing three-valued required/applicability path
Coverage mechanism: COVERAGE_PROFESSIONAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED + most_severe() in coverage.py
Existing patterns: test_rh_s13_indeterminate_determination_when_proposal_omitted, R5 height/setback exception-bearing rule tests
outputs: Exception-predicate missing-optional-input routing to indeterminate/PRR with trace note (no contract change)
DF-6 regression test cases; all existing rules suites green
acceptance_scenarios: AS-1: exception condition reading a MISSING optional input routes the evaluation to COVERAGE_PROFESSIONAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED with a trace note naming the missing input and the indeterminate exception - never a silent False/skip
AS-2: all-inputs-present exception behavior unchanged (R5 height/setback and full exception regression suite)
AS-3: missing optional input NOT referenced by any exception predicate keeps existing COMPLETENESS_MISSING_NONCRITICAL note behavior
AS-4: required/applicability three-valued indeterminate path unchanged (existing tests)
AS-5: rule_evaluation contract schemas byte-unchanged (both copies); responses still validate; if a contract change proves necessary the producer returns needs_split instead of changing it
AS-6: worktree attestation recorded before first write (D-004-R302); evidence + requested status returned, no git/gh/CLI writes (D-004-R303)
